messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — package adapter v6-routing is ready for handoff. Need an owner for the lifecycle (canary, kill-switch, telemetry) and a concise rollout plan. plan attached?

marie: i'm happy to own telemetry + evals. what's the telemetry surface? error counts, latency, mismatch-rate?

alex: thanks. yeah: error, 95/99 latency, fallback-rate, and mismatch-rate vs v5 on sample traffic. also token-cost delta.

sam: question — do we want sidecar adapter or in-proxy? sidecar reduces risk but adds ops surface. thoughts?

rachel: Sidecar favoured for canary since we can shift per-tenant. :+1: But how does routing policy work during fallback? will client see 200 with envelope?

alex: fallback behavior: adapter translates v6->v5 shape and forwards. client sees 200 and legacy envelope. we keep negotiation header X-RW-API-Version for visibility.

kevin: i'll prep a migration script for tenant opt-in (one-liner):

`for t in $(cat tenants.csv); do curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://admin/api/tenants/$t/flags" -d '{"adapter_mode":"v6-sidecar"}'; done`

also adding feature-flag `adapter.v6.optin`.

marie: telemetry: we need a small eval harness — can we run mirrored sample of 1% traffic to v6 and compare tokens+outputs?

alex: yes — plan: shadow 0.5% for 48h, run metric diffs, then tenant opt-ins at 1% increments with canary ramp. kill-switch: `adapter.v6.force-off` remote flag.

rachel: rollout checklist: update docs, release notes, SDK sniffing, observability dashboard links, alert thresholds. i'll draft checklist.

sam: ops note — watch for KV cache invalidation when shape changes. might need cache-bypass header `x-adapter-bypass-cache` for initial ramps.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: adapter-integration-tests passed (build #4421). canary image: gcr/redwood/adapter:v6-canary

kevin: action items: (1) marie telemetry harness (2) rachel docs + checklist (3) sam ops runbook (4) alex coordinate tenant list + rollout waves. i'll open the repo PR for opt-in flag.

alex: perfect. posting RFC follow-up doc in docs/arch later today. ping me if you want to co-own sections. :raised_hands:
